content.scenarioBrief: A junior analyst asks their manager for a two-day extension on a quarterly report that is due on Friday.

turns.text: Morning. Before we start, how is the quarterly report coming along?
It is going well, but I am a bit worried about the time. Could I have two more days to finish the analysis?
Two days is more than I expected. What is still missing?
I need to check the figures from the sales team and write the summary. If I send the first draft on Monday, would that be acceptable?
That works if you send me the headline numbers on Friday. Let us agree on that.
